name: Banderling Castle
title: Banderling Castle
summary: A small Tumerok-built fort full of Banderlings at 66.2N 2.3W. Its 48 m square courtyard is closed by 24 m stone walls (5 m high, spiked with wooden stakes) on the north, east and south, with a low hall on the west. Two 31 m five-storey spire towers stand at the north-west and south-east corners, and the north-east and south-west corners are open gates. A pitched-roof bunker hall sits in the middle, holding the Camping Mastery chest bunker. In the kit, 21 Banderling Guard and 8 Raider generators fill the fort, pines up to 32 m ring it, and the Life Stone is 98 m south-west.
